thread:
maria_ops: Heads-up — Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 reporting 6x failed A40s (returned with mismatched serials). RMA shows replacements currently in APAC manifest (ETA ~14d). We need replacements within 72h to avoid throttling customer traffic. AWB on APAC manifest: AWB123456789CN. Can we reroute / expedite?

jack_vendor: Hi Maria, looking into it. APAC manifest is mixed: legacy SKU 040A and newer 040B. We can allocate 4 units from an EU inbound shipment arriving next week, but 2 are only available in APAC. Options: (1) expedite air from APAC (~48–72h) at extra cost, (2) pull from US reserved lot (needs swap approval), or (3) send 2x 040B with vendor preflash to match firmware.

sam_procurement: If we pull from our US lot we need to update the PO/commit. Swap fee applies — what is the fee and lead time?

jack_vendor: Swap fee is $120/unit administratively; US -> EU express transit ~72–96h door. Expedited APAC air estimate: ~€1,700/unit including insurance. We can consolidate with other RMAs to save ~15% if you approve single AWB.

ryan_infra: Firmware mismatch is risky for our latency-sensitive workloads. If we accept 040B with preflash, we need vendor-provided smoke test logs and guarantee on perf parity. Otherwise prefer identical SKUs.

anna_logistics: To avoid customs delays, mark shipments as "replacement under warranty" on commercial invoice and include original RMA ref. HS code to use: 8471.50.00. I can handle consolidation but need final AWB and manifest 24h prior. Also confirm whether returns are being shipped back at same time — we need return labels to be generated.

leo_warehouse: EU-AMS site can receive and stage, but require serial manifest CSV 24h before arrival. CSV header should be: serial,sku,model,fw_version,lot,awb. If we get preflash units, we still need to run acceptance tests and attach results to the manifest.

maria_ops: Understood. We can accept preflash only if vendor runs the backport and provides: (a) test logs for cuda_smoke.sh, (b) perf baseline against batch50, and (c) commitment to immediate swap/credit if perf deviates >5%. Also need turnaround SLA — 72h for delivery and staging.

jack_vendor: We can preflash and run tests in our lab. Will include logs and firmware checksum. For the 2 APAC units expedited by air: total estimate €3,400 (door-to-door incl insurance) for both. Need PO amendment for expedite and confirmation to consolidate AWBs. We will also pre-generate return labels — please confirm return address.

sam_procurement: Approve PO amendment for expedite up to €4,000 total for the two units. Use Redwood EU returns address: Redwood EU-AMS Depot, Attn: Warehouse Ops.

maria_ops: Approved. Please also attach the manifest as CSV in this thread and include per-unit fw_version value. Jack — before you ship, CSV needs the serials and AWB mapping.

jack_vendor: Will do. Draft manifest (snippet):

```
serial,sku,model,fw_version,lot,awb
SN-A40-001,040B,A40,fwv3.2.1,LOT-77,AWB-EU-0001
SN-A40-002,040B,A40,fwv3.2.1,LOT-77,AWB-EU-0001
SN-A40-003,040A,A40,fwv2.9.8,LOT-73,AWB-AP-1234
SN-A40-004,040A,A40,fwv2.9.8,LOT-73,AWB-AP-1234
```

jack_vendor: I'll replace placeholders with real serials and attach the full CSV. Shipping note: we will preflash SN-A40-003/4 to fwv3.2.1 and include lab test results.

shipbot: RMA label created: RMA-2069012345. Manifest request queued; upload deadline 24h before departure.

maria_ops: Thanks — once manifest and test logs are here I'll post to eng-runbook and trigger acceptance smoke. Please cc @ryan_infra on the final manifest. :thumbsup:
